author: A

components.title: Compute remaining fill time
components.what:
Both pumps fill at 1/12 + 1/9 = 7/36 tank per hour, so in 4 hours they fill 7/9 and leave 2/9; pump B needs (2/9) ÷ (1/9) = 2 hours = 120.0 minutes.
FINAL: 120.0

log.author: A
log.draft:
Working:

Rate of A = 1/12 tank/hour
Rate of B = 1/9 tank/hour
Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/9 = 3/36 + 4/36 = 7/36 tank/hour

In 4 hours together: 4 × 7/36 = 28/36 = 7/9 tank filled.

Remaining = 1 − 7/9 = 2/9 tank.

Pump B alone finishes remaining at rate 1/9 tank/hour:
Time = (2/9) ÷ (1/9) = 2 hours = 120 minutes.

Check: verify 7/9 + 2/9 = 1 (tank fully filled) ✓
Check: verify (2/9)/(1/9) = 2 exactly, no rounding needed, so 120.0 is exact to one decimal place.

FINAL: 120.0
